messages:
maya: Quick check — planning to cut over APAC-CNA (sgp3) this Thu 18:00 SGT. Need final routing policy ack and data residency signoff. Owners: routing=liam, infra=sana, security=raj. Canary window 2h. Any blockers?
liam: I reviewed the policy, one small tweak for the prefer-local fallback weight. PR up: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/842 — please review before EOD.
 olivia: tagging infra/ops for capacity verification — @sana can you confirm reserved pool will handle canary + burst capacity?
 sana: confirmed reserved pool = 4x A10G for the canary, autoscale policy will allow 2x burst. No quota conflicts that I can see. Will run smoke deploy Thu-14:00 SGT.
 tim: heads-up: routing change needs an ACL update for the residency filter. I can apply but need security ok.
 raj: Security OK with the ACL change as long as logs are enabled + KMS key is customer-approved. Can we add KMS key id in the rollout doc?
 maya: yes will add KMS id. Also adding the data residency checklist to the runbook: 
```
- confirm KMS key id
- verify audit logs to SIEM (splunk)
- confirm no cross-region replicas for user blobs
- update privacy policy link
```
liam: CR ping to @olivia @tim for the routing policy diff. Small snippet: 
```
route_preference: [apac-local, apac-fallback, global]
fallback_weights: {apac-fallback: 0.2, global: 0.05}
```
 olivia: LGTM on the weights, only comment is to add a comment in the code explaining 0.05 global fallback for degraded infra cases.
 infra-bot: smoke deployment scheduled: Thu 14:00 SGT -> job id: job-3347. Logs: https://ci.internal/jobs/3347
 eng-oncall-bot: Canary window reminder set for Thu 18:00 SGT (2h). Pager policy: oncall=eng-oncall, escalation after 10m.
 maya: action items summary: 1) liam update PR with comment + merge after OL/Tim review, 2) sana run smoke deploy Thu 14, 3) raj confirm KMS id added to runbook, 4) tim apply ACL at canary start, 5) olivia + tim approve routing by EOD Wed. Anyone else to add? :thumbsup:
 liam: I'll push the PR update in 30m.
 sana: I'll post smoke deploy results in this thread.
 raj: KMS id added to runbook, leaving note about retention policy.
 olivia: approving after I check small doc comment — will do now.
 maya: perfect — thanks team. If no major regressions during smoke we'll proceed with canary Thu 18:00 SGT.
